content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ESIC Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies in ESIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 43 vacancies for Super Specialists, Specialists and Senior Residents posts in ESIC Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in ESIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The posts available are Super Specialists (Cardiology, Oncology), Specialists (General Medicine, Radiology, Casualty, General Surgery, Pulmonology, Ophthalmology, Orthopedics, Anaesthesia), and Senior Residents across various specialities.

faq.question: Q3. What is the walk-in interview date for ESIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for ESIC Recruitment 2026 is scheduled for 17 August 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for ESIC Various Posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for ESIC Various Posts is 69 years, with age relaxation applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: General/OBC candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 250/- for ESIC Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required for Super Specialists posts?
faq.answer: For Super Specialists, candidates need MBBS and MD/DM/DNB in the concerned speciality, such as Cardiology or Medical Oncology.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary range for the recruited posts?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 100000 to Rs. 240000 per month, depending on the post and whether it's full-time or part-time.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for ESIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for ESIC Recruitment 2026 involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted in Ernakulam, Kerala, with pincode 683501. Candidates should refer to the official notification for the exact venue address.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for Women candidates?
faq.answer: No, Women candidates are exempted from paying any application fee for the ESIC Various Posts recruitment.
